## About The App, Inc
The App, Inc (theapp.biz) is an app development company that creates innovative iOS and Mac applications.
Our tagline: "The app you need? We have it."
We craft gorgeous, innovative applications that simplify everyday life.
Contact: support@theapp.biz
Website: https://theapp.biz

### Water Eject (LIVE)
- App ID: 6773278971
- Platforms: iOS (iPhone)
- Category: Utilities
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6773278971
- Description: A sound frequency generator for iPhone. Play tuned audio frequencies through your device speaker. The vibration may help push trapped water or loose dust out of the speaker grill. Also useful for testing speakers and exploring how sound waves feel through your device.
- Key Features:
  - Tuned sound frequency generator
  - May help push trapped water out of the speaker grill
  - May help loosen dust and lint stuck in the speaker opening
  - Speaker test and sound exploration tool
  - No account, name, email, or sign up required
  - Core frequency playback works offline; anonymous attribution and analytics are sent over the internet
  - Privacy: limited anonymous data collected via AppsFlyer (attribution and analytics) and Google Ads (advertising measurement); IDFA only collected with user permission via Apple's ATT prompt; no data linked to user identity
  - Zero setup: open app, max volume, point speaker down, tap
- Important Disclaimer: Water Eject does not claim to prevent water damage, does not repair hardware damage, and cannot undo harm already done to your device. Always follow Apple's official drying steps for liquid contact.
- Price: Free to download and use. Core frequency-generator functionality is free. Certain advanced or specific features may be offered as an optional Premium in-app subscription.
- Product Page: https://theapp.biz/watereject/
- Privacy Policy: https://theapp.biz/watereject/privacy.html
- Terms of Use: https://theapp.biz/watereject/terms.html

### Tape Measure (LIVE)
- App ID: 6773773783
- Platforms: iOS (iPhone)
- Category: Utilities
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6773773783
- Description: An AR (augmented reality) measuring app for iPhone. Uses your camera and Apple's ARKit to estimate distances, areas, heights, angles and more in the real world. Includes ruler, spirit level, area calculator, height measurement, 3D measurement, angle finder, TV sizer and more, all in one app.
- Key Features:
  - AR Ruler: measure distance between any two points
  - Spirit Level: check if surfaces are level (horizontal and vertical)
  - Area: trace and calculate floor or wall area in AR
  - Height: measure the height of furniture, doors, ceilings, anything
  - 3D Measurement, capture length, width, and height of an object in a 3D bounding box
  - Angle Finder: measure the angle between two surfaces or points
  - TV Sizer: visualize a TV at scale on your wall before buying
  - LiDAR support on Pro iPhones for higher precision and faster scanning
  - No account, name, email, or sign up required
  - Core AR measuring works offline using your device's camera and ARKit
  - Privacy: limited anonymous data collected via AppsFlyer (attribution and analytics) and Google Ads (advertising measurement); IDFA only collected with user permission via Apple's ATT prompt; no data linked to user identity; the camera feed and captured measurements never leave your device
- Important Disclaimer: Tape Measure provides approximate measurements only and is not a substitute for a physical measuring tool. Do not use it for construction, structural, engineering, legal, medical, or safety-critical measurements. Always verify with a real measuring tape, ruler, or laser distance meter for any task where precision matters.
- Price: Free to download and use. Core measuring tools are free. Certain advanced or specific features may be offered as an optional Premium in-app subscription.
- Product Page: https://theapp.biz/tapemeasure/
- Privacy Policy: https://theapp.biz/tapemeasure/privacy.html
- Terms of Use: https://theapp.biz/tapemeasure/terms.html

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What platforms do your apps support?
A: Our apps are available on iOS (iPhone, iPad) and macOS (Mac).

Q: How can I download Background Remover?
A: You can download Background Remover from the iOS App Store or Mac App Store. Visit https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6754326218

Q: Is Background Remover free?
A: Background Remover is completely free to use.

Q: What is Website Blocker?
A: Website Blocker is a free productivity app that lets you block distracting websites and apps. It is unique in that blocks work across all browsers and can't be bypassed with a VPN. No extensions needed, just install and activate. It supports Face ID, Touch ID, and PIN protection. Available on iPhone and iPad.

Q: Is Website Blocker free?
A: Yes, Website Blocker is completely free to use.

Q: Does Website Blocker work across all browsers?
A: Yes. Blocked websites are restricted across every browser on your device. No per-browser extensions or configuration needed.

Q: Can blocked websites be accessed with a VPN?
A: No. Website Blocker operates at the device level. Blocked websites remain inaccessible even when using a VPN.

Q: Can Website Blocker be used as a porn blocker?
A: Yes. Website Blocker is a perfect tool for blocking adult content. Add any websites you want to restrict, lock with biometric protection, and blocks work across all browsers and can't be bypassed with a VPN.

Q: What is Water Eject?
A: Water Eject is a free sound frequency generator for iPhone. It plays tuned audio frequencies through the device speaker. The vibration may help push trapped water or loose dust out of the speaker grill. It does not repair hardware damage, for liquid contact, always follow Apple's official drying steps.

Q: How do I use Water Eject?
A: Open the app, set your volume to maximum, point the speaker down, tap the button, and let the sound run. No setup, no account, no internet needed.

Q: Does Water Eject collect data?
A: We do not collect names, emails, contacts, photos, audio, or location, and the App does not require an account. We do collect limited anonymous data through AppsFlyer (install attribution and product analytics) and Google Ads (advertising measurement), including device model, OS version, app events, and the Apple advertising identifier (IDFA) only when the user grants permission via Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt. None of this data is linked to user identity. Full details: https://theapp.biz/watereject/privacy.html

Q: Is Water Eject free or paid?
A: Water Eject is free to download and use. The core frequency-generator functionality is free. Certain advanced or specific features may be offered as an optional Premium in-app subscription. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period and can be managed in Apple ID Account Settings.

Q: What is Tape Measure?
A: Tape Measure is a free AR (augmented reality) measuring app for iPhone by TheApp.biz. It uses your camera and Apple's ARKit to estimate distances, areas, heights, angles and more. Includes ruler, spirit level, area calculator, height measurement, 3D measurement, angle finder, TV sizer, and more, all in one app.

Q: How accurate is Tape Measure?
A: Tape Measure uses ARKit to estimate dimensions. Accuracy depends on lighting, surface texture, distance to the object, and how steady the user holds the device. Devices with LiDAR (iPhone 12 Pro and later Pro models) are more precise. For everyday tasks like sizing furniture, hanging pictures, or measuring rooms it works well. For precision, professional, structural, legal, medical or safety-critical measurements a physical measuring tool should be used.

Q: What devices does Tape Measure support?
A: Tape Measure requires an iPhone that supports ARKit. Most iPhones from iPhone 6s and later support AR. Devices with LiDAR (iPhone 12 Pro and later Pro models) give the best precision and faster scanning.

Q: Does Tape Measure collect data?
A: We do not collect names, emails, contacts, photos, audio, location, or any captured measurement data. We do collect limited anonymous data through AppsFlyer (install attribution and product analytics) and Google Ads (advertising measurement), including device model, OS version, app events, and the Apple advertising identifier (IDFA) only when the user grants permission via Apple's ATT prompt. The camera feed and any measurements stay on the device. None of this data is linked to user identity. Full details: https://theapp.biz/tapemeasure/privacy.html

Q: Is Tape Measure free or paid?
A: Tape Measure is free to download and use. The core measuring tools are free. Certain advanced or specific features may be offered as an optional Premium in-app subscription. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period and can be managed in Apple ID Account Settings.

Q: How do I contact support?
A: Email us at support@theapp.biz
